experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8 and 9.9 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT) for one context: seven outer words and eight members from the seed, the test of W, the 39 context lines; per member its walk of seven full blocks of 2^16 steps (t_hi below 2^19), each of constant X0 >> 16 with the level-16 test of automaton (2); per live block the first eight words of the list of its state cut for the member's class (Lemma CP), with the packed Y9 fill, the exact packed Y9 prefilter of Lemma PF (a word with no lane that can pass test (1) is skipped), the T1 replicas and the word test on kept words; per passing lane the shortcut, the pre-check of 9.7, the preflight, the joint screen of 9.9 and the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15), with the root predicate; for a certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. In-run checks: those of proof.md 9.2, with every 61st skipped word re-tested with T1 (uncharged; a pass is a mismatch). The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, t_hi = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library. Stated before the run of plan PREREG6W3: plan SHA-256 32298b5dd4787a45d96007ea5928197e7d476b24d07e69d9ff9b771c43ebdae6; program SHA-256 c7c94d6da889bc91061713741741813283c26fb86726480a71cf95d8f9ad56b8. The program of the base entry 99503bea differs from the PREREG6W3 program only in the kept-word budget constants and asserted figures. This derivative's program differs from the base only in U_PF = 6, the prefilter constants and test (Lemma PF), MU_P6 = 4025 and the asserted figures; the metered-debit run PREREG6W4 of entry 8947920c (plan SHA-256 72a5d11bacfad8f78f0ce726bc68333dbace499ab5bff8f088df00f194ebea80, program SHA-256 9831feeaeb0b3e72bda8f4f07c31fc0cd29256a2d75b75ed710a3ed68f5fc856) is cited for MU and not rerun here.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted: blocks, live, ranges, words, e_lanes (kept words' lanes), passes, prechecked, solver_calls, roots, certified, units, solver_units, checks, mismatches, halted, live_steps. Expected per trial (outcome set S of three rows, proof.md 9.10): 56 blocks, about 3.6 live, 28 words of which about 3 kept (about 20 E lanes), 0.4 passes, 0.1 prechecked and 0.015 solver calls, almost always no root; mismatches and halted 0. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost. The member reads the list of its class (kept words, E_KEPT = 24345360). Preregistration PREREG6W (H_PF on the class-list walk, 16384 whole contexts) was written before its run; plan SHA-256 969c7a90e4d6188252405e75107a578191c469762a3d1b4604ad137c1fca9e59, program SHA-256 790fed53d01e79ccf702746178e5f0b08c72426f9e47e9aa4cd85c65b1122b80.
